description: This file defines the 'Component' class in the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Vue' namespace, representing a Vue component with properties such as name and props, along with methods for managing these properties.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: A class representing a Vue component with a name and properties, providing methods to manipulate them.

methods.name: __construct
